question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Nargis quickly picks out the important files from her office shelf.

options.text: The important files are quickly being picked out by Nargis from her office shelf.
The important files will be quickly picked out by Nargis from her office shelf.
The important files are quickly picked out by Nargis from her office shelf.
The important files have quickly been picked out by Nargis from her office shelf.

solution:
The correct answer is** "The important files are quickly picked out by Nargis from her office shelf."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in active voice with the subject (Nargis) performing the action (picking out the important files).
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object (important files) the subject and the subject (Nargis) the object of the preposition **"by".**
 
• The verb **"picks out" **becomes **"are picked out"** in the passive voice, and the adverb "quickly" remains the same.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **This option is in passive voice, but the verb tense is incorrect. It should be "are picked out" instead of "are being picked out".
 
• **Option 2:** This option is also in passive voice, but it uses the future tense ("will be picked out") which is not appropriate for the given sentence.
 
• **Option 4: **This option is in passive voice and has the correct verb tense, but it uses the present perfect tense ("have been picked out") which is not necessary in this case.
